annotations.text:
Rebuilt tonight: skin first.

Today opens on 'Your skin today' — what to hydrate and moisturise with, what to go easy on, and a home-care idea. The cycle is now a small card underneath.

New: a Guide tab for every phase, routine steps instead of yes/no, a skin-type question at setup, and a 'Don't try this at home' list.

Every remedy and product tip was checked against the AAD, NHS, DermNet and published studies. Honey and aloe vera were dropped because the evidence didn't hold up.

Idea A — Shelf Sync
Your own products, used at the right time in your cycle.

For: anyone with a few products, deciding what to reach for tonight.
First version: add a product (name + its main active from a short list). Today says lean into / ease off, with a one-line why.
Left out: barcode scans, a brands database, reorder reminders.
Keep it honest: effects are modest and individual — always 'ease off', never 'stop'.

Why it matters: it turns tonight's guide into advice about HER bottles. Nothing on the market crosses the products you own with your cycle phase.

BUILT OVERNIGHT: a working prototype on branch idea/shelf-sync (folder ~/Projects/skincare-app-shelf-sync). Its rules were checked line by line against the guide and five were corrected. Tested in the ovulatory, luteal and menstrual phases.

Idea B — Skin Report
Six weeks of your own logs on one honest page.

For: the night before a pharmacist or GP visit, or a monthly check-in.
First version: phase averages, routine vs skin, top tags — saved as a PDF. Notes left out unless ticked.
Left out: photos, predictions, share links.
Keep it honest: small samples — the same 'quiet until true' rules as the pattern, and 'linked', never 'causes'.

Why it matters: it gives the tracking a real payoff, and shows your data-analysis skill (Project 1).

BUILT OVERNIGHT: a working prototype on branch idea/skin-report (folder ~/Projects/skincare-app-skin-report). With only sample data it refuses to report; with real entries its numbers matched an independent calculation.

Idea C — Steady Start
From no routine to one you keep.

For: the complete beginner overwhelmed by reels.
Already built tonight: step-by-step routine ticks and the phase guide.
Still to build: pick your own steps at setup (three-step default, with 'why this order'), and consistency shown next to the skin pattern.
Left out: reminders, streak badges, product lists.
Keep it honest: test every addition against 'does this make starting easier?'

A and B now exist as working prototypes, each on its own branch — the main app is untouched.

My suggestion: try Shelf Sync first, and merge it if it feels right.

It makes tonight's product guidance personal, and it's the most different from what's already out there. B needs a few weeks of real logs before it's worth anything, so it comes after. C is mostly done tonight — finish its routine builder when you polish setup.

Where these came from: three agents each looked at the app through one lens — the complete beginner, the products she owns, and insight over time.
